submission_recommendation_reason: Cycle 1 has no supported positive result: C1-NUM is contradicted and C2-C4 are inconclusive because no confirmatory runs were executed. The comprehensive record recommends returning to the science gate before any journal submission.

claims.claim_text: Minimal model under non-degenerate small-perturbation initial conditions preserves wealth conservation and non-negativity, and main observables converge in time step.
claims.journal_representation: The numerical-calibration gate passed conservation, non-negativity, and equal-state absorption, but failed stationarity and dt-convergence.

claims.claim_text: After matching total resource, pixel histogram, and accessible area, clustered resource landscapes produce population-spatial-structure differences beyond numerical noise relative to spatially shuffled landscapes.
claims.journal_representation: No confirmatory matched-landscape runs were executed, so no landscape effect is claimed.

claims.claim_text: The landscape effect can be decomposed through a movement-channel by production-channel 2x2 factorial ablation into quantifiable main effects and an interaction effect.
claims.journal_representation: No channel-ablation effect estimates were produced because E2 was blocked before execution.

claims.claim_text: The core effect remains directionally consistent across preregistered population sizes, grid resolutions, and held-out landscape families.
claims.journal_representation: No robustness holdout runs were executed, so scale, resolution, and held-out-family direction consistency are unassessed.

limitations: E0 numerical calibration failed on dt_convergence and stationarity, so the frozen SESOI cannot yet be used as a confirmatory threshold.
B0 dynamics-health pilot failed the stationarity gate for all three seeds while passing wealth non-negativity, fixed population, and finite-metric checks.
No confirmatory E1-E3 numerical runs were executed; C2-C4 therefore have no direct empirical evidence and remain inconclusive.
The candidate parameter lock remains non-final (candidate_pending_non_evidentiary_runtime_pilot_and_e0) and confirmatory execution is not authorized.
The evidence boundary is synthetic generative mechanism only; no claim about specific civilizations, states, empires, or historical causation is permitted.
Wealth dynamics show strong time-step sensitivity (wealth Gini changes by 0.26584885869833064 between dt/2 and dt/4), so wealth observables are not discretization-converged.
Cycle 1 disables reproduction, mortality, culture, technology, loyalty, conquest, taxation, and polity classification, so the results cannot speak to those mechanisms.
journal_recommendation: Do not submit this Nature version in Cycle 1. Return to the human/science gate, revise the candidate parameter lock using only runtime and outcome-blind health diagnostics, rerun E0-NUMERICS until conservation, non-negativity, dt-convergence, and stationarity all pass, then re-submit E1-E3. Only a future passing cycle should condense the comprehensive record into a Nature submission.
